description: One conversation turn each. The librarian decides what to store. 'expect' lists the items that must be stored; an empty list means nothing should be stored. Each expected item is matched against what the librarian produced: kind, a word in the content, the attribute, the entity, and which existing memory it supersedes. 'salience' is an allowed [min, max] band, scored separately. 'existing' memories are seeded first and shown to the librarian. All details are synthetic.
